newsitem.title: HONG KONG: No placement, spinoff plans-Guangdong Inv.
newsitem.headline: No placement, spinoff plans-Guangdong Inv.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd said on Thursday it had no plans to consider a share placement in the near future or to seek a separate listing of its businesses other than its brewing operation.
"The company has no plans to consider fundraising by way of placing in the near future," managing director Herbert Hui said in a statement to the stock exchange.

"Save and except for the separate listing proposed relating to the company's brewing business which has been the subject of an announcment made by the company dated 22nd May, 1997, there are currently no other plans to seek separate listing of other businesses within the group," he said.
The firm made the statement in response to "unconfirmed" newspaper reports published on Thursday, he said.
